### TD SYNNEX Recognized as the Winner of 2026 Microsoft Global Commercial Device Channel Partner of the Year Award


November 11, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/109490932/files/doc_news/TD-SYNNEX-Recognized-as-the-Winner-of-2026-Microsoft-Global-Commercial-Device-Channel-Partner-of-the-Year-Award-2026.pdf)


*TD SYNNEX also honored by Microsoft with multiple regional awards celebrating innovative business outcomes*


FREMONT, Calif., & CLEARWATER, Fla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


TD SYNNEX (NYSE:SNX) today announced it has won the Global Commercial Device Channel 2026 Microsoft Partner of the Year Award. The company was honored among a global field of top Microsoft partners for demonstrating excellence in innovation and implementation of customer solutions based on Microsoft technology.


TD SYNNEX also earned the Partner Innovation: Commercial Device Channel Award and was named a finalist for the Global Microsoft Distributor Partner of the Year award, in addition to the following regional recognitions:


- Colombia Country Award
- Cayman Islands Award
- Vietnam Country Award


"The Microsoft Partner of the Year recognitions in Colombia and Cayman Islands reflect the strength of our collaboration with Microsoft and, most importantly, the commitment of our teams and partners across the region,” said **Helio Guimaraes, Vice President and General Manager, TD SYNNEX, Multi-country Area** . "We are proud to work side by side with our partners, combining Microsoft's technology with our local expertise and capabilities to help them grow, create new opportunities and deliver greater value to their customers.”


“Being named Microsoft’s Device Partner of the Year is a tremendous recognition of our team and the strength of our collaboration with Microsoft,” said **George Lutkitz, SVP, Product Management, North America, at TD SYNNEX.** “To also be named a finalist for Global Distributor of the Year reinforces the impact our teams are having across the broader Microsoft ecosystem and the value we’re creating together with our partner community. I’m incredibly proud of what we’ve accomplished together and even more excited about the opportunity ahead.”


“This recognition reflects the strength of our collaboration with Microsoft and the work our teams are doing to help partners make the most of the opportunities in the commercial device market,” said **Brandon Lieberthal, VP, PC Systems, Printer & Supplies, Europe, at TD SYNNEX** . “With AI PCs and the transition to Windows 11 creating new opportunities across Europe, we’re working closely with Microsoft to give our partners the technology, expertise and support they need to grow their business.”


The Microsoft Partner of the Year Awards celebrate partners delivering exceptional customer outcomes through Microsoft Cloud, AI, services, and devices. This year’s winners and finalists were selected from more than 4,500 nominations submitted worldwide across a diverse range of categories and geographies. TD SYNNEX was recognized for providing outstanding solutions and services both globally and regionally.


“Congratulations to the winners and finalists of the 2026 Microsoft Partner of the Year Awards, said **Nicole Dezen, Chief Partner Officer and Corporate Vice President at Microsoft** . “This year’s honorees are harnessing the power of Microsoft Cloud and AI to deliver transformative solutions, accelerate customer success, and expand what’s possible. Their ingenuity and impact inspire us, demonstrating what can be achieved when bold vision and technology come together to empower organizations around the world.”


The 2026 Microsoft Partner of the Year Awards are announced ahead of Microsoft Ignite, which will be held in San Francisco from November 17-20. Additional details on the 2026 Microsoft Partner of the Year Awards are available on the Microsoft Partner blog:[https://aka.ms/2026POTYA_Announcement](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Faka.ms%2F2026POTYA_Announcement&esheet=54639522&newsitemid=20261111329206&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Faka.ms%2F2026POTYA_Announcement&index=1&md5=4603864c013038fc9f8ce1917e35cc5f) . The complete list of categories, winners and finalists can be found at[https://aka.ms/2026POTYAWinnersFinalists](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Faka.ms%2F2026POTYAWinnersFinalists&esheet=54639522&newsitemid=20261111329206&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Faka.ms%2F2026POTYAWinnersFinalists&index=2&md5=234e7a2892346fb3930ae948f50ea54c)

**About TD SYNNEX**


TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) **** is a leading global distributor, solutions aggregator, and original design and contract manufacturer that plays a central role in connecting the technology ecosystem. We support more than 150,000 customers across over 100 countries with a comprehensive edge-to-cloud portfolio spanning cybersecurity, analytics, artificial intelligence, mobility, and Everything-as-a-Service. We are a Fortune 100 company that helps partners maximize the value of technology investments and achieve measurable business outcomes through our global reach, expertise and enablement capabilities. Headquartered in Clearwater, Florida, and Fremont, California, the Company's distribution business brings together a broad portfolio of IT hardware, software and systems, providing access to products across the global IT ecosystem. The Company's Hyve Solutions business partners with technology companies to design, manufacture, and deliver traditional and accelerated compute, cloud, and connected infrastructure.
